title: appointments.appointments.create
description: An appointment is booked against REAL records (appointments#21): the customer, the service and the professional are LINKS to the customers/services/staff modules, not free text. Booking with a typed-in service name produced appointments the per-professional agenda could not group, the availability engine could not honour and the appointment→sale handoff could not price. The denormalized name/price/phone travel WITH the ids as the historical snapshot of the booking (§1: never read another module's private tables).

settings.description: Lectura aportada por el caller (fila de appointments.settings.get): el runtime no precarga lecturas para el handler WASM; el guest usa allow_overlapping/default_duration de aquí.

existing_appointments.description: Fallback de citas candidatas a solape (de appointments.appointments.list del día) si el runtime NO precargó la read autoritativa. Desde appointments#110 el comando `create` declara `reads` sobre `appointments.appointments.conflicting`, que el runtime inyecta en `context.reads` y el handler prioriza por encima de este campo.

service.description: Lectura aportada por el caller ({name, price} resuelto vía el contrato público del módulo services) para denormalizar cuando service_name viene vacío.
